retailers: Online at www.eleanorrose.com from November 2014 through February 2016 for about $30.

title: CE North America Expands Recall of Fan Heaters Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at H-E-B
hazards: The fan heaters can overheat, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled fan heaters and contact CE North America for instructions on returning the recalled heaters with a prepaid shipping label. The firm will issue a refund check upon receipt of the returned fan heaters.
retailers: H-E-B grocery stores in Texas from September 2015 through December 2015 for about $15.

title: Grosfillex Recalls Commercial Side Chairs and Armless Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
products: Havana side chairs and armless bar stools
hazards: The backrest can crack and detach, posing a fall hazard to the user.

hazards: When configured in a certain way, the panels can become non-responsive and connected detectors in the area can fail to detect and respond to an alarm.
remedies: Consumers should immediately contact the distributor to obtain the free repair, a firmware upgrade.
retailers: Authorized distributors from May 2015 through August 2015 for about $800.

retailers: BuyBuy Baby and other toy stores nationwide, and online at Amazon.com and Kohls.com from September 2015 through January 2016 for about $15.

title: Creating X Recalls Children's Pajamas Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard (Recall Alert)
hazards: The pajamas fail to meet the federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children.

retailers: Online at www.Amazon.com, www.footedpajamas.com, www.sears.com and www.Zulily.com for $20 for infant sizes, $25 for toddler sizes and $30 for kids sizes.

title: Black Diamond Recalls Nylon Runners Due to Fall Hazard
hazards: A nylon runner with a tape splice (two cut ends joined by masking tape) will fail in normal use, posing a risk of death or injury due to a fall.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled nylon runners, inspect for the presence of a tape splice and contact Black Diamond for instructions on obtaining a free replacement nylon runner.
retailers: Eastern Mountain Sports, Hansen Mountaineering, The Gear Coop, Peak Experiences Inc., REI and other specialty outdoor stores nationwide and online at Backcountry.com and BlackDiamond.com from January 2014 through February 2016 for between $5 and $9.

title: Toshiba Recalls Laptop Computer Battery Packs Due to Burn and Fire Hazards
products: Panasonic battery packs used in Toshiba laptop computers
hazards: The lithium-ion battery packs can overheat, posing burn and fire hazards to consumers.
remedies: Consumers should immediately go to the firm's website and click on the battery pack utility link in the first shadowed box on the page. Consumers can also perform a manual check using the laptop and battery pack's model, part and serial numbers. If it is part of the recall, consumers should power off the laptop, remove the battery and follow the instructions to obtain a free replacement battery pack. Until a replacement battery pack is received, consumers should use the laptop by plugging into AC power only.
manufacturers: Panasonic, of Japan
retailers: Office Depot, Staples and other electronics stores nationwide, and online at Toshibadirect.com and other websites from June 2011 through January 2016 for between $500 and $1,000 for the laptop and between $70 and $130 for the battery pack.

title: Black Diamond Recalls to Inspect Carabiners Due to Fall Hazard
hazards: The carabiner can unexpectedly open and allow the rope to become detached, posing a risk of injury or death to climbers from a fall.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled carabineers and contact Black Diamond for instructions on inspecting and returning the product for a free replacement. Instructions are also available on the firm's website.
retailers: Eastern Mountain Sports, The Gear Coop, Hansen Mountaineering, REI and other specialty outdoor stores nationwide and online at Backcountry.com, BlackDiamond.com and Bouldering.com from December 2014 to January 2016 for between $6 and $15.

hazards: The lopper handles can break when attempting to cut branches, posing a risk of serious injury and laceration.

Return them an authorized Specialized bicycle retailer for a free repair for Flux model headlights, or a free replacement for Flux model taillights, and Stix model headlights and taillights. Consumers who bought the bicycle lights directly from Specialized should contact Specialized for return instructions.
retailers: Authorized Specialized retailers nationwide and online at www.specialized.com from June 2014 through February 2016 for between $100 and $275 for Flux model headlights and taillights and for between $30 and $50 for Stix model headlights and taillights.

title: Panasonic Recalls Lithium-ion Laptop Battery Packs Due to Fire Hazard

remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the laptop computer with the recalled battery, power off the device, remove the battery pack and contact Panasonic for a free replacement battery pack.
retailers: Panasonic dealers from December 2011 through August 2013 for about $2,000 for the laptop.

Crew is contacting known purchasers directly.

title: SRAM Recalls Zipp 88 Bicycle Wheel Hubs Due to Crash and Injury Hazards
products: Zipp 88 aluminum hubs for bicycle wheels
hazards: The hub flange ring on the front hub can fail posing a crash and injury hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using bicycles equipped with the recalled Zipp 88 front hub and contact SRAM for a free replacement hub.
manufacturers: Prodigy Group, Mooresville, Ind.
retailers: Specialty bicycle retailers nationwide. Front hub sold for about $215; front wheel with the hub sold for about $920; front and rear wheel set sold for about $2300 and bicycles with the wheel set containing the recalled hub sold for about $5,000 to $12,000. Items were sold between October 2008 and December 2010.

title: Jackco Transnational Recalls ZETA Battery Pack Due to Fire Hazard
products: ZETA by Jackco Pocket Jump Starter - Deluxe Set
hazards: The battery packs can overheat, split apart and melt the battery pack's enclosure, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled Pocket Jump Starter and contact Jackco Transnational for instructions on how to dispose of the product and how to obtain a refund for the purchase price. Consumers without a receipt will receive $110.
retailers: Retailers nationwide and at Amazon.com from July 2014 to January 2015 for between $110 and $140.

title: System Sensor Recalls Combination Carbon Monoxide and Smoke Detectors Due to Carbon Monoxide Hazard
products: i4 Series System Sensor combination carbon monoxide (CO)/smoke detectors
hazards: The detectors can fail to detect carbon monoxide gas in the home, posing a risk of carbon monoxide poisoning.
remedies: Consumers should immediately contact System Sensor to obtain a free replacement combination CO/smoke detector. Consumers should keep using the recalled detectors until replacement detectors are installed.
manufacturers: System Sensor, of St. Charles, Ill.
retailers: Security equipment dealers nationwide during September 2014 for about $75.

title: Marin Mountain Bikes Recalls Children's Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Handlebars Can Loosen
products: 2014 Marin MBX 50 and Tiny Trail Bicycles
hazards: The handlebars can loosen or separate during use. This can cause the rider to lose control and/or crash, posing the risk of injury.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled bicycle and contact Marin for a replacement handlebar stem.
retailers: Bicycles stores nationwide from September 2013 through December 2014 for about $250.

title: Mima Recalls Moon 3-In-1 High Chairs Due to Fall and Impact Hazard
hazards: The high chair seat can loosen and dislodge, allowing the seat and child to fall. The chair can also fall onto a child crawling underneath the seat, posing an impact hazard to the child.
remedies: Consumers should stop using the high chair immediately and contact Mima to receive a free replacement upper chair section or instructions on receiving a refund.
manufacturers: Sparklegate Industries, of Dongguan, Guangdong, China, through a contract manufacturing relationship with Mima International Limited, of Hong Kong
retailers: The majority of the high chairs were given away at the May 9, 2014 taping of the Ellen DeGeneres television show. The remaining chairs were sold at children's juvenile product stores in California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, New Jersey, New York, Puerto Rico, Texas and Virginia from February 2014 through September 2014 for about $500.

title: Airplane and Butterfly Push Toys Recalled by LS Import Due to Choking Hazard
hazards: The wheels of the airplane and the balls at the tip of the butterfly's antenna can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled toys away from children and contact LS Import for a full refund.
retailers: LS Import stores in Houston, Texas from May 2014 through July 2014 for between $1 and $2.

title: Sea Gull Lighting Recalls Chandeliers Due to Injury Hazard
hazards: The chandelier's screw collar that holds the chandeliers to the ceiling mount can break causing the chandelier to fall and injure bystanders.
remedies: Consumers should prevent people from going into the immediate area under the chandeliers. Contact Sea Gull Lighting immediately to receive a free replacement for chandeliers that have fallen, including shipping, or for free replacement hardware to repair the chandelier and instructions on being reimbursed for the full cost of the installation.
manufacturers: Sea Gull Lighting Products, LLC., of Skokie, Ill.
retailers: Aztec Electric Supply, Ferguson, Lowe's, State Electric Supply, Wesco and other retailers nationwide and online at Amazon.com, HomeDepot.com and other online retailers from November 2006 through August 2013 for between $250 and $750.

title: Children's Pajamas and Robes Recalled by Lazy One Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
hazards: The footed pajamas and robes fail to meet the federal flammability standard for children's sleepwear, posing a burn hazard to children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled pajamas and robes away from children and return them to Lazy One for a free replacement garment, including shipping.
retailers: Department stores and children's boutiques nationwide and online at www.lazyone.com from October 2013 through June 2014 for about $22 for the pajamas and about $15 for the robes.

title: Lifesmart Recalls Lifepro Brand Portable Mini Space Heaters Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
hazards: The screws used to attach the back plate to the heater are too short and allow the back plate to detach when removing the heater from the outlet, posing an electrical shock hazard to the user.
remedies: The firm is no longer in business. The remedy is no longer available. Destroy and dispose of this recalled product.
retailers: Meijer stores, Northern Tool stores, QCI Direct stores and Tuesday Morning stores nationwide and online at Amazon.com, BJs.com, HomeDepot.com, QCIDirect.com, Samsclub.com, Walmart.com and Wayfair.com from January 2014 through December 2014 for between $40 and $50.

title: Family Dollar Stores Recall Tough Treadz Auto Carrier Toy Sets Due to Laceration Hazard
hazards: The die-cast metal cars can have sharp edges that pose a laceration hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled toy sets, take them away and return them to any Family Dollar Stores location for a full refund.
retailers: Family Dollar Stores nationwide from September 2014 through December 2014 for about $5.

title: Performance Packaging Recalls Children's Food Pouch Attachment Due to Choking Hazard
hazards: The tube of the pouch topper that screws onto the food pouch can separate from the round base, posing a choking hazard to young children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled PouchPop toppers and contact Performance Packaging for instructions on receiving a free replacement product or full refund.
manufacturers: Performance Packaging, of Las Vegas, Nevada
retailers: Online at www.Amazon.com, www.littlegreenpouch.com and www.jackbenatural.com from May through September 2014 for about $10.

title: Gibbs Sports Amphibians Recalls Quadski Amphibious Vehicles Due to Injury Risk
hazards: The handlebar can fail while the vehicle is in operation, causing the operator to lose control of the steering and braking system of the vehicle, posing a risk of injury.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled vehicles and contact an authorized dealer for a repair at no cost.
manufacturers: Gibbs Sports Amphibians Inc. of Auburn Hills, Mich.
retailers: Gibbs Sports Amphibians dealers nationwide from January 2012 through October 2014 for about $42,000.

title: Sunbeam Recalls Holmes Oil Filled Heaters Due to Scald Hazard
hazards: The oil-filled heaters can spray heated oil, posing a scald hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled heater, unplug it and contact Sunbeam for instructions on how to obtain a full refund.
retailers: Target and small department stores nationwide from August 2014 through November 2014 for about $50.

title: Vosges Haut-Chocolat Recalls Festival of Lights Gift Box Sets Due to Fire Hazard (Recall Alert)
hazards: The plastic menorah can catch fire if candles are allowed to burn to the base of the menorah.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using candles in the menorah and contact Vosges for a full refund. Vosges is contacting consumers directly.
retailers: Vosges Haut-Chocolat boutiques in Chicago, Beverly Hills, Calif.; New York and Las Vegas and online at vosgeschocolate.com from November to December 2014 for about $160.

title: Mirka Extends Recall of Compact Electric Random Orbital Sanders Due to Fire Hazard
hazards: The sander can short circuit, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Customers should immediately stop using the recalled sanders, unplug them and contact Mirka Abrasives for a free replacement.
retailers: Various distributors and independent retailers nationwide and at Amazon.com, Beavertools.com and other online retailers from March 2014 to November 2014 for about $500.

title: Hunters’ Tree Stands Recalled by Primal Vantage Due to Fall Hazard
products: Ameristep Hyde Cliff Hanger and Sky Walker Tree Stands
hazards: The cast aluminum platform can break, causing the user to fall to the ground and suffer serious injuries.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled product and contact Primal Vantage for a full refund.
manufacturers: Primal Vantage Co., of Bernardsville, N.J.
retailers: Bass Pro Shops and other sporting goods stores nationwide from July 2014 through November 2014 for between $220 and $250.

title: Johnson Health Tech Recalls Matrix Fitness Strength Training Machines Due to Risk of Impact Injury, Laceration and Fall Hazards
products: Matrix Fitness Varsity series strength training machines
hazards: The handle attachment on the strength training machines can detach during use and hit the user with force and/or cause the user to lose balance and fall. This poses a risk of impact injury, laceration and fall hazards.
remedies: Owners should immediately prevent people from using the strength training machines and contact Johnson Health Tech North America to schedule a free repair.
manufacturers: JHTNA Manufacturing LLC, of Milwaukee, Wis.
retailers: Johnson Health Tech North America and its fitness equipment dealers nationwide from July 2013 through October 2014 for between $3,300 and $4,000.

title: La-Z-Boy Recalls Control Wands Sold With Silver Luxury Lift Chairs Due to Burn Hazard (Recall Alert)
products: La-Z-Boy Control Wands sold with Silver Luxury Lift Chairs
hazards: The wand that controls the chair's movements can overheat, posing a burn hazard.
remedies: Consumers should unplug the chair from the wall outlet and contact the local dealer from whom they purchased the chair who will schedule a time for a service technician to install a free replacement control wand.
retailers: La-Z-Boy Furniture Galleries stores and independent furniture stores nationwide from August 2014 through November 2014 with the Silver Luxury Lift Chair for between $900 and $1700.

title: CR Brands Recalls Mean Green Cleaner and Degreaser Products Due to Chemical Hazard
products: Mean Green® Super Strength Cleaner & Degreaser and Mean Green® Industrial Strength Cleaner & Degreaser
hazards: The products are labeled "Does not contain Ammonia." The products may contain ammonia. The mislabeling of the bottles can pose a chemical hazard to consumers. If ammonia is mixed with bleach or other household chemicals, irritating or toxic gases could be produced.
remedies: Consumers who have a product with the UPC and date code should immediately discontinue use of the product and return it to the retailer for a replacement.
manufacturers: CR Brands, Inc., West Chester, OH
retailers: Dollar General, Dollar Tree, Family Dollar, Fred's, Walmart and small retailers nationwide from August 2014 to November 2014 for between $1 and $8.

title: NPD Furniture Recalls Dining Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
hazards: Chair legs can break unexpectedly, posing a fall hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the product and contact NPD Furniture for a full refund.
retailers: Various home furnishing retailers nationwide between July 2014 and November 2014 for about $200.

title: IKEA Recalls Crib Mattresses Due to Risk of Entrapment
hazards: The crib mattresses could create a gap between the mattress and crib ends larger than allowed by federal regulations, posing an entrapment hazard to infants.
remedies: Consumers should inspect the recalled mattress by making sure there is no gap larger than the width of two fingers between the ends of the crib and the mattress. If any gap is larger, customers should immediately stop using the recalled mattresses and return it to any IKEA store for an exchange or a full refund.
retailers: IKEA stores nationwide and online at www.ikea-usa.com from August 2010 to May 2014 for about $100.

title: Pro Performance Recalls SKLZ Resistance Trainers Due to Risk of Severe Injury
hazards: A weld on a ring on the resistance trainer's belt can break during use and cause the resistance trainer's flexible cord to quickly and unexpectedly retract and hit an exercise partner who is holding the other end.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled resistance trainers and contact SKLZ to return them for a free replacement resistance trainer, including free shipping.
retailers: Academy LTD, Dick's Sporting Goods and other sporting goods and fitness stores; sporting goods and fitness catalogs; and online at SKLZ.com and Amazon.com from January 2013 through December 2014 for about $40.

title: Children’s Pajamas Recalled by Star Ride Kids Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standard
hazards: The pajamas fail to meet federal flammability standards for children's sleepwear, posing a risk of burn injuries to children.
remedies: Consumers should immediately take the recalled pajamas away from children, stop using them and return them to the place of purchase for a full refund.
retailers: Children's boutiques and department stores nationwide from August 2013 through November 2013 for between $10 and $13.

title: CoScentrix Expands Recall of DD Brand Candles Due to Fire Hazard; Exclusively at Hobby Lobby
hazards: The candle's high flame can ignite the surface of the wax, posing a fire hazard.
remedies: Consumers should immediately stop using the candles and return them to the nearest Hobby Lobby. Consumers with a receipt will receive a full refund. Consumers without a receipt will be issued a store credit. Online purchasers should contact CoScentrix for instructions on returning the product.
manufacturers: CoScentrix, of Carson, Calif.
retailers: Hobby Lobby stores nationwide and online at HobbyLobby.com from June 2014 through October 2014 for between $6 and $20.
